_about: Suggested starting points for Repo Improvement. Pages on this site name a catalog id and exact ## headings (tools/check-worksheets.mjs fails if a heading stops matching). 'test' is 'desk' (read and edit anywhere), 'sim' (a simulator in a browser) or 'hands-on' (where-you-can-do-it labels come from that page's own catalog entry). 'external' items live on another site: linked, never bundled, and the student pastes the section text. 'planned' pages don't exist yet and are listed without links.

items.focus: Read these two sections side by side. The first says not to adjust the audio preamps; the second says to press PFL to check/adjust F8 gain. Write up the contradiction and the questions it raises for the instructor. Don't decide which is right, and don't try either on the real F8.
A packing-and-prep section you can check on paper. Is every item something you could actually tick off? What's missing, ambiguous, or explained here when it belongs in a reference?
Short and self-contained, and the meter tells you whether it worked. Needs the stereo recording kit.
Pick one camera only (G50, GH5, or AX100) and test just its five controls.
Does the page tell you enough to find and name each cable without asking anyone?
